name: Michael Braun
office: Walnut Valley Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 2

items.text: Michael Braun is a criminal justice professor running for the Walnut Valley Water District Division 2 board. His campaign says he supports water rates that reflect the cost of reliable service, with increases publicly justified. He proposes investing in infrastructure and making decisions openly.
